description: Ask the SecureNow forensics chat a question about one app's traces, logs, errors and custom events, in plain English. Without conversationId it starts a new conversation (applicationKey or applicationId required); with conversationId it continues that conversation, including ones started in the dashboard or the CLI, and the chat sees the earlier questions, their SQL, findings, and the IPs and trace IDs in their results. The reply has the chat's reasoning, any discovery queries, the SQL, up to 100 result rows and findings: what the rows show. Read-only over telemetry. Waits up to 90 seconds; a reply still running after that comes back with status processing (use securenow_forensics_chat_status). Status awaiting_confirmation means the query is large: run it with securenow_forensics_chat_confirm or ask a narrower question.

applicationId.description: App database id, instead of applicationKey.

applicationKey.description: App key the new conversation is scoped to. Not needed with conversationId.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

conversationId.description: Continue this conversation. Omit to start a new one.

environment.description: Environment of a new conversation: production (default), staging, preview, local or test. Omit it when continuing: a conversation keeps its environment.

message.description: The question, in plain English. Follow-ups can refer to earlier answers ("those IPs", "that session").

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

name: securenow_forensics_chat
title: Ask the Forensics Chat
